extra.reason: Frontend built: Vite+React+TS, router, supabase-js, @twa-dev/sdk, HashRouter routing. Pages: Home (live balance ticker), Buy (purchase form), MyMachines (per-machine accrual), Drop (gated by settings.drop_enabled), Refer (tg deep link + stats). Admin pages under /admin/* guarded by is_admin JWT claim: Dashboard, Purchases (with level lookup), Drops (with live balance warning), Settings (drop toggle + payment numbers + machine catalog), Users. BalanceTicker uses server-anchored snapshot + 1Hz local interpolation; re-syncs every 30s.

Admin Panel built at /admin/* guarded by is_admin JWT claim. Dashboard (stats), Purchases (approve/reject with reason modal, level lookup from user_machines), Drops (approve/reject with live balance warning), Settings (drop toggle, payment numbers editor, machine catalog editor with active toggle), Users (search by telegram_id/name). Admin edge functions: admin-approve-purchase (also pays referral bonus on first active machine for a referred user), admin-approve-drop (validates against live balance).

Per-second math verified (1 day = 86400s). L1=2000/86400=0.023148, L2=0.046296, L3=0.081019, L5=0.127315, Super=0.277778 MMK/s. Implementation: computed-on-read via v_level_rate + v_user_balance views (NUMERIC(18,8) no float drift). Client uses v_user_balance_snapshot fetched every 30s and interpolates at 1Hz. No cron needed.

All 5 migrations written (0001 schema, 0002 RLS with is_admin() JWT helper, 0003 views v_level_rate/v_user_balance/v_user_balance_snapshot, 0004 seed machines_catalog + default settings, 0005 custom_access_token_hook). Edge functions: tg-auth (HMAC-SHA256 initData validation, upsert user, referral parsing, admin session mint), admin-approve-purchase (approve/reject + referral bonus), admin-approve-drop (server-authoritative balance check). Supabase project creation blocked by OAuth scope in this environment; documented manual setup steps in README.md (project URL, link, db push, deploy functions, set BOT_TOKEN + ADMIN_TG_IDS, activate Custom Access Token Hook).
